note: Test lines for the comparison of speech models. 'text' is what the game would show, 'spoken' is the same line written out the way it is to be said (radio discipline for digits, units in words): every model gets 'spoken', so that the models are compared and not their text normalisers. 'names' lists the invented words of a line: a speech recogniser cannot judge those, so they are scored apart from the ordinary words. 'listen' marks the few lines the owner hears on the audition page; all lines are rendered for the measurements. 'raw' lines are given as 'text' to see what a model's own normaliser does; they are never part of the listening set.
